Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (small blast radius); minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it MAJOR; google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite gave no severity. The highest is used.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:open_earlier_reports() line 966 (the "aud_titles" list comprehension); redact_earlier_items() lines 974-996; render_model_input() line 1288 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: redact_earlier_items() rewrites only report["items"]; the "### AUD-###: <title>" lines go into report["aud_titles"] unchanged and reach the model, so a title such as "AUD-003: Fix scope guard in owner/secret" leaks the plain private name.
  WHY: The earlier-report-plans block in model-input.md holds the plain private name, the model is asked to cite earlier AUD titles and may copy one into analysis/issue-pr-audit-<date>.md, and that file is committed to the public default branch through a chore-skip PR with no reviewer panel; this defeats the README redaction contract. The trigger needs an open earlier report written with redaction off, so the blast radius is small.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: "scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh gains APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA (default analysis/issue-pr-audit-*.md; none disables it)"; "APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA=none stops the hand-off" kill switch.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml lines 1573 and 1837 and .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml line 187; add APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA: ${{ vars.APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA || 'analysis/issue-pr-audit-*.md' }}.
  Evidence of absence: Only APPLY_ANALYSIS_ON_MAIN_ENABLED is exported. No workflow references the variable, and the PR changes neither workflow. The docs only describe the workaround. The editor, not the issue, deferred this because the files are outside files_touched, so it needs a tracked follow-up issue.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: "## Metrics Appendix: API calls, tokens and cost, durations."
  Expected change site: ipa_analyze() in scripts/issue_pr_audit_run.sh; finalize_report() in scripts/issue_pr_audit.py.
  Evidence of absence: Literal --metric "model_tokens=unavailable" and --metric "model_cost=unavailable" are passed, and no engine usage or cost is read.
- HARDENING: scripts/issue_pr_audit.py redact_earlier_items() "for report in earlier" loop. While redaction is active, apply re.sub (re.escape(name), re.IGNORECASE) to replace each redacted audited repo with repo_display(name, True) in aud_titles, then drop titles that still contain unknown github.com links or blank the whole list. About 6-8 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: A private repository name or private-item detail in an earlier title can end up in a new audit report committed to a public repository, which violates the redaction requirements (#10153 D7).

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:974-996 (`redact_earlier_items`); 966 (`open_earlier_reports` extracts `aud_titles`); 1288 (`render_model_input` puts them into the model input) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: redact_earlier_items only rewrites report["items"]; aud_titles taken from `### (AUD-[0-9]{3}: .+)$` lines pass unchanged into the prompt as <untrusted_external_data source="earlier-report-plans">, so a plain private owner/repo can be echoed into a new committed report.
  WHY: The helper already knows which audited records are redacted (`audited` map) but uses it only in the items loop. A small redaction pass over aud_titles would close the gap; without one, a private repo name from an unredacted earlier report can leak into a redacted current report.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Requirement: Issue #10153 Implementation Steps 9 + §18.E + README "Turning it off": APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA (default analysis/issue-pr-audit-*.md; none disables hand-off). The PR description notes it "doesn't work yet".
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` and `.github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml` steps invoking scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh should export `APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA: ${{ vars.APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA || 'analysis/issue-pr-audit-*.md' }}`.
  Evidence of absence: Neither file is in files_touched or changed in the PR DIFF or LAST RUN DIFF, and both export only APPLY_ANALYSIS_ON_MAIN_ENABLED. The documented claim that "=none ... stops the hand-off" cannot be honoured by setting the variable alone.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  Requirement: Issue #10153 Approach §Telegram and Metrics Appendix — "API calls, tokens and cost, durations".
  Expected change site: `scripts/issue_pr_audit_run.sh` `ipa_analyze`; `scripts/issue_pr_audit.py` `finalize_report`.
  Evidence of absence: ipa_analyze passes only model_attempt, model_seconds, engine_rc, model_tokens=unavailable and model_cost=unavailable. Neither engine exposes token usage, and finalize_report writes what it is given, so two of the five rows are always unavailable.
- HARDENING: scripts/issue_pr_audit.py redact_earlier_items (around lines 974-996). Add a second pass over report.get("aud_titles") that substitutes repo_display(name, True) for redacted audited repos, drops a title when redaction is active and the repo is unknown, and dedupes the result. About 8 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
